title: SafeVLA: Towards Safety Alignment of Vision-Language-Action Model via Constrained Learning

layout.note: Three panels on the top row (A, C, D) and the wide panel B under them; dotted black arrows carry the task from A into B and trajectories from B up into C, a teal funnel arrow carries C into D, and two code boxes at the right are tied to a cylinder in B by dashed leaders.

lesson: Draw a multi-aspect pipeline as lettered grey panels, using thick dotted arrows for hand-offs between panels and thin solid arrows inside them; show a store of components as a cylinder and tie real code boxes to it with dashed leaders.
